Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding records requests relating to prevailing wage investigations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prevailing wage records requests; and adding anew section to chapter 39.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any employer, contractor, or subcontractor who fails to providerequested records, or fails to allow adequate inspection of records inan investigation by the department of labor and industries under thischapter within sixty calendar days of service of the department'srequest may not use the records in any proceeding under this chapter tochallenge the correctness of any determination by the department thatwages are owed, that a record or statement is false, or that theemployer, contractor, or subcontractor has failed to file a record orstatement.
